verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const S='scripts/check-cache-budget.mjs';if(!fs.existsSync(S))process.exit(79);const src=fs.readFileSync(S,'utf8');const bad=[];const m=/const\s+PACKED_PER_RAW\s*=\s*([0-9.]+)/.exec(src);if(!m)bad.push('PACKED_PER_RAW is gone, so nothing converts raw bytes into the units Vercel weighs');if(m&&(parseFloat(m[1])<0.52||parseFloat(m[1])>0.56))bad.push('PACKED_PER_RAW is '+m[1]+', outside the 0.52-0.56 band (2026-09-29 pair implied 0.5454, rounded up to 0.55; lowering toward 0.264 is still the mix-error)');if(!/mib\(nodeModules\)/.test(src)||!/mib\(nextCache\)/.test(src))bad.push('the composition line no longer prints node_modules and .next/cache separately, so the ratio can no longer be re-derived from a build log');if(!/Uploading build cache/.test(src))bad.push('the gate no longer tells the reader to compare its estimate against the build own upload line, which is the only way this constant gets re-checked');if(bad.length){console.error(bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)};process.exit(0)"
verify.note: Measures the CONSEQUENCE: that the constant stays inside a two-sided band, and that the two things which make it RE-DERIVABLE survive — the composition line printing node_modules and .next/cache separately, and the printed instruction to compare the estimate against the build's own upload line. Losing either leaves a number nobody can check. The lower bound still forbids lowering toward the empty-cache ratio of 0.264, the exact error this row was filed about. The upper bound moved from 0.54 to 0.56 on 2026-09-29 (HYG-136, ADR-1619) so the 0.55 round-up of the 1.42/1.38 pair is not a false regression. The first draft of this probe matched the composition line with a template pattern and failed for a reason that had nothing to do with the file: probes run through a shell, which expanded the parameter reference away before node saw it. It matches the interpolated calls instead.

append.detail: AMENDED 2026-09-29 (HYG-136, ADR-1619). PACKED_PER_RAW moved from 0.53 to 0.55, rounded up from the 2026-09-29 production pair (estimate 1.38 GB, upload 1.42 GB, implied 0.5454). The probe band's upper edge moved 0.54 to 0.56 so that round-up is not a false regression. The lower edge stays 0.52: lowering toward 0.264 is still the mix-error this row forbids.
